name: Huétor Vega (Spain)
description: Garnet red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huétor Vega (a pomegranate on white above waves, inscribed).
history: Huétor Vega adopted its arms officially on 9 August 1985 and its flag on 22 June 2018; the flag is rectangular of 3:2, garnet red, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Huétor Vega arms — pomegranate above waves, inscribed
